modules.name: dns.providers.cloudflare
modules.docs: dns.providers.cloudflare wraps the provider implementation as a Caddy module.

modules.name: http.authentication.providers.authorizer
modules.docs:
http.authentication.providers.authorizer authorizes access to endpoints based on
the presense and content of JWT token.

modules.name: http.handlers.authenticator
modules.docs:
http.handlers.authenticator implements Form-Based, Basic, Local, LDAP,
OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SAML Authentication.

modules.name: security
modules.docs: security implements security manager.

modules.name: layer4
modules.docs: layer4 is a Caddy app that operates closest to layer 4 of the OSI model.

modules.name: layer4.handlers.echo
modules.docs: layer4.handlers.echo is a simple handler that writes what it reads.

modules.name: layer4.handlers.proxy
modules.docs: layer4.handlers.proxy is a handler that can proxy connections.

modules.name: layer4.handlers.proxy_protocol
modules.docs: layer4.handlers.proxy_protocol is a connection handler that accepts the PROXY protocol.

modules.name: layer4.handlers.tee
modules.docs:
layer4.handlers.tee is a layer4 handler that replicates a connection so
that a branch of handlers can concurrently handle it. Reads
happen in lock-step with all concurrent branches so as to
avoid buffering: if one of the branches (including the main
handler chain) stops reading from the connection, it will
block all branches.

modules.name: layer4.handlers.throttle
modules.docs: layer4.handlers.throttle throttles connections using leaky bucket rate limiting.

modules.name: layer4.handlers.tls
modules.docs: layer4.handlers.tls is a connection handler that terminates TLS.

modules.name: layer4.matchers.http
modules.docs:
layer4.matchers.http is able to match HTTP connections. The auto-generated
documentation for this type is wrong; instead of an object, it
is an array of matcher set objects.

modules.name: layer4.matchers.ip
modules.docs: layer4.matchers.ip matches requests by remote IP (or CIDR range).

modules.name: layer4.matchers.ssh
modules.docs: layer4.matchers.ssh is able to match SSH connections.

modules.name: layer4.matchers.tls
modules.docs:
layer4.matchers.tls is able to match TLS connections. Its structure
is different from the auto-generated documentation. This
value should be a map of matcher names to their values.

modules.name: layer4.matchers.xmpp
modules.docs: layer4.matchers.xmpp is able to match XMPP connections.

modules.name: layer4.proxy.selection_policies.first
modules.docs:
layer4.proxy.selection_policies.first is a policy that selects
the first available host.

modules.name: layer4.proxy.selection_policies.ip_hash
modules.docs:
layer4.proxy.selection_policies.ip_hash is a policy that selects a host
based on hashing the remote IP of the connection.

modules.name: layer4.proxy.selection_policies.least_conn
modules.docs:
layer4.proxy.selection_policies.least_conn is a policy that selects the upstream
with the least active connections. If multiple upstreams
have the same fewest number, one is chosen randomly.

modules.name: layer4.proxy.selection_policies.random
modules.docs:
layer4.proxy.selection_policies.random is a policy that selects
an available host at random.

modules.name: layer4.proxy.selection_policies.random_choose
modules.docs:
layer4.proxy.selection_policies.random_choose is a policy that selects
two or more available hosts at random, then
chooses the one with the least load.

modules.name: layer4.proxy.selection_policies.round_robin
modules.docs:
layer4.proxy.selection_policies.round_robin is a policy that selects
a host based on round-robin ordering.

modules.name: http.matchers.client_asn
modules.docs:
http.matchers.client_asn matches requests by the client_ip GeoIP ASN.

Caddyfile syntax:

	@asn-matcher client_asn "24940"
	respond @asn-matcher "Hetzner Online GmbH"

Logging:

	ERROR Failed to parse client IP
	ERROR Failed to get ASN for client IP
	WARN  No data for client IP
	INFO  Request matched

modules.name: http.matchers.client_country
http.matchers.geoip_asn
modules.docs:
http.matchers.geoip_asn matches requests by the client_ip GeoIP ASN.

Caddyfile syntax:

	@asn-matcher geoip_asn "24940"
	respond @asn-matcher "Hetzner Online GmbH"

modules.name: http.matchers.geoip_country
modules.docs:
http.matchers.geoip_country matches requests by the client_ip GeoIP Country.

Caddyfile syntax:

	@country-matcher geoip_country "HU" "DE"
	respond @country-mathers "Country matcher"
